usage: As a noun, 飲水 (jam2 seoi2) refers to the action or concept of drinking water.
In sentences, 飲水 can be used to talk about the habit or need to drink water.
飲水 can be combined with verbs or adjectives to describe when, how, or how much water is drunk.
It is often used in everyday conversation relating to health and hydration.
